resume: A generative groovebox in the spirit of early-90s tracker music: six lanes (lead, arp, pad, bass, drums, sfx) composed live in ten styles. You mix styles instead of programming steps.

commandes.role: SOUND group (reverb, filter, resonance, wobble, brightness, drive...); again: next setting.
Fades the selected track out then back in.
A new idea for the track.
The track's steps, bar by bar.
SONG group (key, scale, chords); again: next setting.
PLAY group (volume, style, melody, rhythm...); again: next setting. Held: SETUP.
TRACKER group (slide, retrigger, echo, vibrato...); again: next setting.
Launches the queued style (on EDIT: copies a track).
INTRO then END: starts the song, and a second press ends it with a fade.
Chooses the setting within the group.
Track that the buttons and keys act on; the window slides across the six tracks.
Play the track live; on EDIT, they enter steps.

gestes: REC one press: INTER; REC held: DROP.

modes.texte: Ten styles: EPIC, HYPERSPACE, FUSION, OLDSKOOL, SYMPHONY, TROPIC, STEEL, DRIFT, FUNK and RAVE. You queue them, blend them track by track, or launch them all at once with their tempo.
Off at startup: builds the song from the drums up to a drop, then lets it fall back.

a_savoir: KNOB 1 to 4 set the displayed setting for the four tracks of the window.
